visualCharacteristics.purpose: 500px map of points of interest with location pins, zoom buttons and a title / 'Visit website' bubble per pin on hover or focus
traits: light map (OpenStreetMap tiles softened towards Lufthansa's lightened Google style), attribution bottom right
two dark translucent 40px zoom squares bottom right
deep blue location pins; white bubble with a heading-font title and an optional service link
optional caption under the map and an aside column beside it from 768px

contentPattern.structure: Rows: Source | live JCR path or base64 id (points from GET /service/api/pointsOfInterest/{id}); or point rows Title | Lat, Lng | Link; optional Caption | rich text, Aside | rich content, Tiles | osm|carto; label rows Zoom in label, Zoom out label, Visit website label.

usage: 12 pages x 4 locales (articles/explore-the-world and four of its articles, 100-years/destinations, three stopover partner pages, first-class): the .poimapping component.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any map of a few points; author Source (live data) or point rows. Request and mapper: scripts/lh-api.js pointsOfInterestRequest, mapPointsOfInterest, poiMapId; the block exports readPoiMapRows, readPoiMapSettings, loadPoiMap, fitBounds, project, drawMap for tools/importer/test-widgets.mjs.
